title: Polynomial-time randomized to polynomial-size circuits
statement: Let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If $L$ has a polynomial-time randomized verifier whose acceptance probability is at least $2/3$ on members and whose rejection probability is at least $2/3$ on nonmembers, then $L$ is decidable by a family of fan-in-two circuits of polynomial size.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ belongs to BPP for the specified polynomial-time verifier model
